Taye Arimoro is a professional actor and model based in Lagos. Taye is known for his strong and commanding voice and for  his ability to bring characters to life through his dynamic use of voice, body, actions, and reactions. 

Taye has a robust portfolio of work in TV, film, and stage productions. He has appeared in notable TV shows such as "Castle & Castle" on Ebonylife TV, where he played a pathologist.

Taye Arimoro was lead actor in Niyi Akinmolayan's Casa De Novia on Prime Video, The House of Secrets, Clarence Peters "Inside Life" on Netflix, Inkblot's latest Nigerian football film "When Love Strikes", Anthill's "Criminal" streaming on Prime Video, "Last Year Single" now streaming on Netflix, Russet TV's "There's Something Wrong with the Bamideles", "Son of the Soil" a global action thriller directed by Chee Keong and Taye also played  the lead in Biodun Stephen’s series Roses and Ivy on Prime Video (2024).

Taye Arimoro has also been in various television shows including Africa Magic's "Venge", James Omokwe's "Ajoche" and "The Decision" an adaptation of Cinderella. His recent works are Nollybabes produced by Wignonia and directed by Anu Bamidele (Short film) and “Grind” Season Two directed by Orire Nwani and Joshua “Tso-Tso” on Prime Video (2025).

is a talented actor celebrated for his versatility in stage plays, feature-length films, and short movies. A graduate of EbonyLife Creative Academy, he has honed his craft through formal training and practical experience. Beyond acting, Oluwadurotimi has also directed personal projects and stage plays, highlighting his multifaceted skills in theater and film.

His notable acting credits include roles in the upcoming film Everything Scatter directed by Jade Osiberu, Son of the Soil (2024), a Nigerian-UK action thriller by UK-Chinese director Chee Keong, and The Bride Price under Sunom Kura George’s direction. He also stars as James in Mirrors: James’ Split by Arnold Mafo and appeared in Naija Saga (2022) directed by Akinyemi Tag. On stage, Oluwadurotimi delivered compelling performances as Olunde in Death and the King’s Horseman (2022) and as the Second Chief in The Gods Are Not to Blame (2022), both directed by Ayo Ajisafe.

In addition to acting, Oluwadurotimi has contributed to projects like the short film Ebiren Re (2024) as Godfrey Williams, directed by Yinka Otubusin, and the TV series Cheta’m (2023) as crew/Apoputara, directed by James Omokwe. With a passion for storytelling and an unwavering dedication to his craft, Oluwadurotimi continues to leave a mark on the entertainment industry.

To hone his craft as a professional actor, he trained at renowned film institutes, including EbonyLife Creative Academy, Royal Arts Academy, and the African International Film Festival (AFRIFF) acting masterclass. Currently based in Lagos, Chuks is an accomplished actor and model with a strong presence in the entertainment industry.

Standing 5’9” with an athletic build, Chuks has appeared in numerous blockbuster films (both in cinemas and on streaming platforms), TV shows, music videos, commercials, and fashion shows. His notable works include Dark October, The Origin: Madam Koi-Koi, and Afamefuna on Netflix, Criminal on Prime Video, Leaked and Kokomma on YouTube. He also starred in When Love Strikes, Nigeria’s latest football-themed film. On television, Chuks has featured in series such as Masquerades of Aniedo, Schooled, Nwanyi Ike, Riona, Baby Drama, and Flatmates.

As a model, Chuks was the first runner-up in the 2020 Mr. Ideal Nigeria competition, earning the title of Mr. Ideal Nigeria Earth. He has since been featured in music videos, commercials, and fashion shoots, showcasing his versatility and presence in the modeling world.

Miss Ezeani’s impressive range of characters has garnered significant attention online and has made her an internet sensation. She is undoubtedly one to look out for in the entertainment industry.
